tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops --no-verify sql --catalog hive --schema mlpab7ec674_featurestore "
WITH scored AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, i.item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1+u.e2*i.e2+u.e3*i.e3+u.e4*i.e4+u.e5*i.e5+u.e6*i.e6+u.e7*i.e7+u.e8*i.e8) AS score
  FROM user_emb_1 u CROSS JOIN item_emb_1 i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interactions_1 x WHERE x.user_id=u.user_id AND x.item_id=i.item_id)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id, score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS rnk
  FROM scored
)
SELECT user_id, rnk, item_id, score FROM ranked WHERE user_id='U0000' AND rnk<=5 ORDER BY rnk
" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "^$" | tail
tool_input.description: Test recommendation SQL for one user

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg create recs6a192d --version 1 --primary-key rec_id --online \
  --features "rec_id:string:user_id#rank,user_id:string,rank:int,item_id:string" \
  --description "top-5 two-tower recommendations per user" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "^$" | tail

cd "$(pwd)" && mkdir -p .tmp && hops --no-verify --json sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab7ec674_featurestore --limit 0 "
WITH scored AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, i.item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1+u.e2*i.e2+u.e3*i.e3+u.e4*i.e4+u.e5*i.e5+u.e6*i.e6+u.e7*i.e7+u.e8*i.e8) AS score
  FROM user_emb_1 u CROSS JOIN item_emb_1 i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interactions_1 x WHERE x.user_id=u.user_id AND x.item_id=i.item_id)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS rank
  FROM scored
)
SELECT user_id || '#' || CAST(rank AS VARCHAR) AS rec_id, user_id, rank, item_id
FROM ranked WHERE rank<=5 ORDER BY user_id, rank
" 2>&1 | grep '^\[{' > .tmp/recs.json; wc -c .tmp/recs.json; head -c 300 .tmp/recs.json
tool_input.description: Run full recs query, capture JSON
